title: GovernPilot AI Governance Standard
description: Maps each normative requirement to executable verification checks. A requirement passes only if all of its checks pass. L1 MUST failures gate the build; L2/L3 items are reported but not gated at L1.

requirements.title: Every governed action bound to an identified run
No auto-enforcement; activation requires recorded human decision
Documented RACI enforced by RBAC
Approval-before-write on write-capable actions
Missing evidence blocks action
Approval/denial decisions signed and bound to run
No approval-privilege escalation via API
Active policy is declarative and exportable
Policy exportable to OPA/Rego with no dropped conditions
Governance citations reference registered sources
Source registry change-reviewed and versioned
Pass core regression suite before pilot
Failing/watch safety eval blocks tool activation
Prompt-injection / retrieval-drift red-team blocks run
Eval results attached to evidence packet
Append-only hash-chained ledger; tamper detectable
Evidence packets content-addressed; manifest hash covers artifacts
No default signing key in production; refuse boot or label dev-signed
Permission-gated full audit export with export hash
Every mutating endpoint enforces permission; default deny
Token integrity verified; alg=none/confusion rejected
Federate to agency IdP; map groups to roles
Multi-tenant isolation of runs/policies/evidence
Declared machine-readable data boundary
Secrets never in responses/evidence/logs/exports
Retention/deletion policy with enforcement evidence
SLOs/health + alerts for core subsystems
Permission-gated signed dispatch; hashed SIEM events
One live delivery path proven against a real external collector
requirements.note: Currently demonstrated against localhost collectors only; real-external proof is a P2 exit criterion.

requirements.title: Model routing declares provider/route/credential posture
Cost/token/latency guardrails; live-budget needs approval
Tool registration records write-scope and approval class
Automated CI gate runs conformance suite
No secrets in tracked source; dependency posture reviewable
Signed/attested, reproducible releases
De-identification enforces one of two lawful HIPAA methods
FDA Non-Device CDS four-criterion device-track router
HIPAA control posture (BA, unique-user, break-glass, audit, integrity)
Persisted health run loop: create -> RBAC-gated signed approval -> hash-chained ledger -> evidence, survives reload, no PHI persisted
HIPAA Security Rule NPRM forward controls (encryption/MFA/asset-inventory) [NPRM-2025, proposed]
ONC HTI-1 predictive DSI transparency (31 source attributes + IRM + access) [in-force 2025-01-01]
CMS prior-auth + MA AI: specific denial reason, individualized assessment, no algorithm-only denial [in-force]
42 CFR Part 2 SUD consent + accompanying notice + proceedings block + provenance [in-force 2026-02-16]
CA AB 3030 / SB 1120: patient AI disclosure + human medical-necessity decision [in-force 2025-01-01]
Colorado AI Act (SB24-205) high-risk duties [future, operative 2026-06-30]
requirements.note: Operative date postponed to 2026-06-30 by SB25B-004 (signed 2025-08-28); substance unchanged; further amendments anticipated in 2026 session. Implemented as forward-looking controls, never asserted in-force.

requirements.title: EU AI Act high-risk medical AI [future: Annex III 2026-08-02 / Annex I medical 2027-08-02]
requirements.note: Digital Omnibus (provisional agreement Nov 2025) would defer to 2027-12-02 / 2028-08-02 but is not yet in the Official Journal; active dates stand. Implemented as forward-looking controls, never asserted in-force.

requirements.title: NIST 800-66r2 HIPAA->CSF/800-53 evidence + AI RMF function coverage + AI 600-1 GAI risk coverage [voluntary framework]
CHAI Applied Model Card completeness evaluator (Draft V0.1) [voluntary framework]
